application.surface: The reader reports of the SaasReport app

architecture.flow: The registry names the reader, the engine computes the priority figures from sample data, and the rules state the findings.

utility.learns: What each reader asks, which figures they follow, and what Stripe cannot tell them.
utility.does: Pick a reader and read their questions, figures and findings.

surfaces.how: Shown in the People section, below the reader picker.
Shown in the People section, below the reader picker.

application.surface: The report planner of the SaasReport app

architecture.flow: The planner orders the sections of one report type by the reader's priority figures, and the engine fills in each figure.

utility.learns: That one report type is ordered differently for each of its readers.
utility.does: Open the same report as three readers and compare the order.

surfaces.how: Shown in the People section, after the report order.
Shown in the People section, after the report order.

application.surface: The findings of the SaasReport reports

architecture.flow: The engine computes the figures for this month and the month before, and each published rule that matches becomes a finding with its evidence.

utility.learns: That a finding is a written rule with evidence, and what to look at next.
utility.does: Read each finding and the figures behind it.

application.surface: A calculator on the landing page

architecture.flow: Your four inputs go through three sums: hours, cost each month and cost each year. Nothing leaves your browser.

utility.learns: What hand-built reporting costs you today, with no claim about savings.
utility.does: Change the four inputs and watch the three results.

application.surface: Role-based access in the SaasReport app

architecture.flow: A report is offered only if every data class behind its figures is visible to at least one of the person's Stripe roles.

utility.learns: That access follows Stripe roles, and an unknown role sees nothing.
utility.does: Pick a group of Stripe roles and see the reports it could read.

application.surface: The report pipeline of the SaasReport app

architecture.flow: Stripe data is stored per tenant, turned into figures and findings, worded, rendered to a PDF, stored, and sent as a signed link.

utility.learns: The path one report takes from Stripe data to a reader, and that every stage is still planned.
utility.does: Run the pipeline and read each stage.

surfaces.how: Shown in the Delivery section, after the pipeline.
Shown in the Delivery section, after the pipeline.

application.surface: The schedule of the SaasReport app

architecture.flow: Each cadence reports on the last complete period before the run, in UTC, by integer calendar arithmetic.

utility.does: Read the five cadences and their periods.

application.surface: The number guard of the SaasReport reports

architecture.flow: The guard compares every number in a drafted sentence with the figures the engine computed, and rejects the sentence on any other number.

utility.learns: That AI writes the words and code owns the numbers.
utility.does: Run a grounded sentence and an invented one through the guard.
